title: the ground loop's discovery and shim retire; the heartbeat's page is the cairn device's
intention: The ground loop's device-folder module and its shim retire, and the heartbeat's page (the Heartbeat pane and the beat verb, read from the loop's lock and beat record) becomes the cairn device's, so the ground loop is the heartbeat and nothing else: no shim, no verbs, no roster walk of its own.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: the ground loop still carries a shim with a page and a beat verb, and a device-folder module whose roster walk the rack tool replaced; the outline gives the ground loop no shim and no verbs (5.6.3, 5.6.5).
how: Move the page to the cairn device; inline the loader; delete; reword; red-first proofs in bin and the cairn device.

clauses.claim: the ground loop's device-folder module, its shim and that module's proof are absent from the working tree
no file in the repo names the two modules, their paths, or the shim's two classes (records and caches excepted)
neither module can be imported: each import exits nonzero with No module named
the cairn device's beat_pane_data renders the ground loop's lock as up and its beat record exactly as heartbeat.read_record returns it, and an absent record is the named lack
the cairn device answers verb beat with that data
the cairn device's page, assembled by BaseShim.active_page through CairnShim, carries the Heartbeat pane after the trouble pane, answered rather than absent
the cairn device's charter says it carries the Heartbeat pane

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/cairn/device.py: a module-level beat_pane_data(home=None, now=None), the retired shim's function moved whole (lazy imports of ground_loop.guard and ground_loop.heartbeat's default_home/read_record); CairnDevice's declared_verbs gains 'beat' -> _handle_beat (returns beat_pane_data(), emits beat_answered with the envelope id); declared_panes appends {kind beat, label Heartbeat, handler beat_pane_data} after the trouble pane; intention()'s what says it carries the heartbeat's page. The charter cairn/devices/cairn/intention+why.json gains one sentence through the artifact door naming the Heartbeat pane and the beat verb.
D2: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/intention+why.json: public_interface becomes [ground_loop.heartbeat, ground_loop.guard] through the artifact door.

D3: every caller edits in its own file: probescan and test_token_rotation carry their own _load_module (the retired loader's body); test_ground_loop drops its three pane teeth; the wiring proof's tooth 3 asks reach('cairn') for beat; the three-faces proof drops its test_vi tooth (in no PROVES); the remaining docstrings and the base and rack charters name the rack tool or the cairn device instead.
D4: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/validations/test_discovery.json leaves through cairn artifact remove; git rm the two modules and the module's proof.

D5: the proofs, red-first: bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py gains this ticket's PROVES key 1-3 and a _ground_loop_faces check (paths absent, the name search, the import refusal), spelling every retired name split; cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_the_cairn_page_carries_the_heartbeat.py is new, PROVES 4-7, guarded imports and the house runner.
